canaryCritical.title: [CRITICAL] finish-position queue delivery canary overdue
canaryCritical.description:
Canary rehearsal-canary has not been consumed within 10 minutes.
Runbook: apps/finish-position-cron/docs/prediction-readiness-monitor-design-2026-08-15.md

fields.name: Action
fields.value: Immediately inspect delivery_paused; if true run `bunx wrangler queues resume-delivery finish-position-predict-queue`, then verify canary consumption and prediction rows before acknowledging this incident.

canaryRecovery.title: [RECOVERY] finish-position queue delivery canary overdue
canaryRecovery.description:
Primary prediction queue consumed delivery canaries within the SLO.
Runbook: apps/finish-position-cron/docs/prediction-readiness-monitor-design-2026-08-15.md

fields.name: Action
fields.value: Verify prediction coverage and queue delivery are restored; take no further action unless the incident recurs.
